notes.englishMediumScope: Core literacy DIRECT assessment (LCL-C Phonological awareness and LCL-D Print & alphabet knowledge) assumes ENGLISH-MEDIUM instruction: the rhymes, letters and printed words are English, and the alphabet is the Roman alphabet in the house SATPIN order. Those two strands carry `englishMedium: true` and deliberately carry NO China-MoE crosswalk code, because 语言.阅读与书写准备 describes Chinese literacy readiness and this evidence does not speak to it. A school teaching in a language other than English should report LCL-A, LCL-B and LCL-E for the core language domain and use the separate EFL track (E3/E4/E5) for the child's English letters and sounds; LCL-C and LCL-D should be left unassessed rather than administered in translation. Unassessed milestones are always printed, never hidden.
notes.evidenceLinking: Every scored direct item carries a constructTag. A milestone's evidence is the set of items in its evidenceBand whose constructTag equals the milestone's own constructTag — never a positional slice of the authoring order. The validator fails the build on any mismatch.
notes.sharedEvidence: E6.A5.1 and E6.A5.2 are both evidenced by the single A5 spoken-production item, because the blueprint allows only one E6 item at that band. This is declared, not accidental.
notes.decodability: Any item whose construct is word_reading or cvc_read_* declares the printed word in `decodableWord`. Every letter in it must appear in TAUGHT_LETTERS for that band (Montree Phonics house order) or be a listed heart word. The validator enforces this.
notes.internalFields: distractors[].rationale is INTERNAL item-writer documentation. It is never rendered to a child, parent or teacher on any D2 screen or in any D3 pack, and is therefore exempt from the forbidden-term lint. A future teacher-facing item-review surface must re-lint it before displaying it.
notes.canopyG1: Montree Canopy is band G1, the second tier of this instrument for children of about 6–7 who have outgrown the kindergarten bands. It is the same instrument, not a second one: same domains, strands, three-band model and suppression posture. Its crosswalk anchors are the US Common Core Grade 1 standards (`crosswalk.ccss`) and the UK National Curriculum Year 1 / Key Stage 1 programmes of study (`crosswalk.ukNc`), because ELOF, EYFS and the China MoE 3–6 Guide are all early-years frameworks that stop below this band — those three fields are therefore carried as explicit empties at G1 rather than stretched to fit. `crosswalk.otherAnchor` names the non-statutory framework (CASEL, NAEYC, PSHE, Montessori) a non-academic strand is written against. The EFL track claims no CEFR, Cambridge or Trinity level at this band either, exactly as at A3–A5.
notes.exceededAtA5: Six A5 milestones carry `expectation: "extension"` with evidence in G1 (LCL-D.A5.3/4, COG-A.A5.3, COG-B.A5.3, COG-C.A5.3, E5.A5.3). Until Canopy existed there was no band above A5, so an A5 child could never register as having exceeded the band. These six make that reachable, using the declared extension-evidence shape the bank already uses at A3 and A4.

scoring.note: Criterion-referenced. No percentiles, no peer ranking, no norm tables. Thresholds are conventional, not empirically calibrated — there is no calibration sample.

strands.constructSpec: Sustained attention to a self-chosen activity and willingness to keep going when it is hard.
Choosing work independently and seeking out what comes next.
Trying alternative approaches, asking useful questions, and reasoning about a problem.
Waiting, stopping, adapting to change and returning to calm.
Trust in and communication with familiar adults.
Playing and working with other children and resolving small conflicts.
Recognising, naming and responding to feelings in self and others.
The Montessori courtesies and belonging to a working community.
Understanding spoken language without any reading demand.
Producing spoken language: naming, describing, sequencing and explaining.
Awareness of the sound structure of spoken words, independent of print. ENGLISH-MEDIUM: the rhyme and sound targets are English words.
Concepts of print, letter identification, letter-sound links and first word reading. ENGLISH-MEDIUM: the alphabet is the Roman alphabet in the house SATPIN order.
Purposeful mark-making growing into letters and taught words.
Subitising, one-to-one counting, numeral recognition and the number sequence.
More/fewer, numeral-to-quantity matching, and joining or taking away small amounts.
Naming shapes, continuing repeating patterns and understanding positional language.
Comparing by size, ordering, grouping by attribute and finding the odd one out.
Noticing, questioning, predicting and talking about the living and social world.
Grip, precision and the hand skills the prepared environment asks for.
Whole-body movement, balance and carrying with care.
Managing the body, clothing, food and belongings without adult hands.
Restoring the environment and using real tools for their purpose.
Recognising taught English words from a spoken prompt and a picture array.
Acting on spoken English instructions of growing length and complexity.
Rhyme and sound-position awareness in taught English words.
Linking English letters to their sounds in the house SATPIN order.
Reading short English words built only from letters already taught.
Producing intelligible, appropriate spoken English in a simple exchange.

emerging.zh: 一次只能计划一项工作。

developing.en: Plans two or three works with support.
developing.zh: 在支持下能计划两三项工作。

secure.en: Plans a balanced morning across areas independently.
secure.zh: 能独立规划涵盖各区域的均衡上午。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

chinaMoe: 说明.学习品质.主动性(5-6岁)

statement.en: Asks for a new lesson when they are ready for one.
statement.zh: 准备好时会主动要求新的课程。

emerging.en: Watches other children’s lessons with interest.
emerging.zh: 会有兴趣地观看别人的课程。

developing.en: Asks for a lesson when reminded it is available.
developing.zh: 经提醒后会要求上课。

secure.en: Asks for the next lesson at the right moment for themselves.
secure.zh: 能在合适的时机主动要求新课程。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

chinaMoe: 说明.学习品质.主动性(5-6岁)

statement.en: Tries a different way when something does not work.
statement.zh: 一种方法行不通时会尝试别的方法。

emerging.en: Stops, or hands the work to an adult.
emerging.zh: 停下来或把工作交给成人。

developing.en: Tries a second way after a suggestion.
developing.zh: 经建议后会尝试第二种方法。

secure.en: Tries several ways before asking for help.
secure.zh: 会先尝试多种方法再求助。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

statement.en: Uses a familiar material in a new way during play.
statement.zh: 能用熟悉的材料玩出新花样。

emerging.en: Uses the material only as it was shown.
emerging.zh: 只按示范的方式使用材料。

developing.en: Adds a small change of their own.
developing.zh: 会加入一点自己的变化。

secure.en: Invents new ways and explains them.
secure.zh: 能创造新玩法并加以说明。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

statement.en: Finds more than one way to solve a small problem.
statement.zh: 能想出不止一种办法解决小问题。

emerging.en: Finds one way with help.
emerging.zh: 在帮助下能找到一种方法。

developing.en: Finds a second way when encouraged.
developing.zh: 受鼓励时能找到第二种方法。

secure.en: Offers two or more ways without prompting.
secure.zh: 能主动提出两种以上方法。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

statement.en: Asks a question to work something out.
statement.zh: 会用提问来弄清楚问题。

emerging.en: Shows puzzlement without asking.

developing.en: Asks a simple question about what to do.
developing.zh: 会问一个关于怎么做的简单问题。

secure.en: Asks a question that gets to the heart of the problem.
secure.zh: 能问到问题的关键。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

statement.en: Thinks a problem through before acting.
statement.zh: 行动前会先思考问题。

emerging.en: Acts first, then notices the problem.
emerging.zh: 先行动，之后才发现问题。

developing.en: Pauses and thinks when reminded.
developing.zh: 经提醒会停下来思考。

secure.en: Pauses, plans, then acts.
secure.zh: 会停顿、计划，然后行动。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

statement.en: Explains how they solved something to another child.
statement.zh: 能向同伴解释自己是怎么解决的。

emerging.en: Shows another child what to do.

developing.en: Explains with a few words and gestures.
developing.zh: 用简短的话和手势解释。

secure.en: Explains the steps clearly so the other child can follow.
secure.zh: 能清楚说明步骤，让同伴跟着做。

eyfs.area: Characteristics of Effective Teaching and Learning

statement.en: Waits for a short turn with help from an adult.
statement.zh: 在成人帮助下能短暂等待轮到自己。

emerging.en: Finds waiting hard even with support.
emerging.zh: 即使有支持也难以等待。

developing.en: Waits a short time with an adult nearby.
developing.zh: 成人在旁时能短暂等待。

secure.en: Waits calmly for a short turn.
secure.zh: 能平静地等待短暂的轮候。

statement.en: Stops an action when reminded.
statement.zh: 经提醒能停止某个行为。

emerging.en: Needs to be gently moved away.

developing.en: Stops after one or two reminders.
developing.zh: 经一两次提醒后停止。

secure.en: Stops at the first reminder.
secure.zh: 第一次提醒就停止。

statement.en: Waits for a material that another child is using.
statement.zh: 能等待同伴正在使用的材料。

emerging.en: Takes the material or asks an adult to fetch it.
emerging.zh: 直接拿走或让成人去取。

developing.en: Waits after a reminder of the ground rule.
developing.zh: 经规则提醒后能等待。

secure.en: Waits, and chooses something else meanwhile.
secure.zh: 能等待，并在等待时另选工作。

statement.en: Manages a change in the routine with a little support.
statement.zh: 在少量支持下能适应常规的变化。

emerging.en: Finds changes upsetting and needs comfort.
emerging.zh: 变化会让其不安，需要安抚。

developing.en: Manages a change when told in advance.
developing.zh: 事先告知就能应对变化。

secure.en: Takes changes in their stride.
secure.zh: 能从容应对变化。

statement.en: Waits, takes turns and follows the ground rules without reminders.
statement.zh: 无需提醒即能等待、轮流并遵守班级规则。

emerging.en: Follows the rules with reminders.

developing.en: Follows the rules for most of the day.
developing.zh: 一天中大部分时间能遵守规则。

secure.en: Follows the rules all day and helps others to.
secure.zh: 全天遵守规则并帮助他人遵守。

statement.en: Calms themselves when upset, using a strategy they know.
statement.zh: 难过时能用自己会的方法平静下来。

emerging.en: Needs an adult to help them settle.
emerging.zh: 需要成人帮助才能平静。

developing.en: Uses a known strategy when reminded.
developing.zh: 经提醒会使用学过的方法。

secure.en: Notices the feeling and settles themselves.
secure.zh: 能察觉情绪并自行平静下来。

statement.en: Seeks out a familiar adult for comfort or help.
statement.zh: 会主动寻求熟悉的成人安慰或帮助。

emerging.en: Accepts comfort when it is offered.
emerging.zh: 别人主动安慰时会接受。

developing.en: Goes to a familiar adult when upset.
developing.zh: 难过时会去找熟悉的成人。

secure.en: Goes to a familiar adult and says what has upset them.
secure.zh: 会去找熟悉的成人并说出原因。

statement.en: Responds warmly when an adult greets them.
statement.zh: 成人问候时能友好回应。

emerging.en: Notices the greeting.

developing.en: Returns the greeting with a look or a word.
developing.zh: 用眼神或一个词回应问候。

secure.en: Greets warmly, and often greets first.
secure.zh: 热情回应，并常常主动问候。

statement.en: Asks an adult for help using words.
statement.zh: 能用语言向成人求助。

emerging.en: Shows the problem without words.
emerging.zh: 用动作而非语言表达问题。

developing.en: Asks in a few words.
developing.zh: 能用简短的话求助。

secure.en: Explains what help is needed.
secure.zh: 能说明需要什么帮助。

statement.en: Enjoys sharing news with a familiar adult.
statement.zh: 乐于与熟悉的成人分享自己的事。

emerging.en: Shares when asked a direct question.

developing.en: Shares a piece of news on most days.
developing.zh: 多数日子会分享一件事。

secure.en: Starts conversations and listens to the reply.
secure.zh: 会主动发起对话并倾听回应。

statement.en: Talks with adults about ideas and plans, not only needs.
statement.zh: 能与成人谈论想法和计划，而不只是需求。

emerging.en: Talks mostly about what they need.

developing.en: Talks about what they are making or doing.
developing.zh: 会谈论正在做的事。

secure.en: Talks about ideas and plans and asks the adult’s view.
secure.zh: 会谈想法和计划，并询问成人的看法。

statement.en: Accepts guidance from an adult and acts on it.
statement.zh: 能接受成人的指导并照着做。

emerging.en: Accepts guidance reluctantly.

developing.en: Accepts and follows guidance most times.
developing.zh: 多数时候能接受并照做。

secure.en: Accepts guidance readily and puts it to use.
secure.zh: 欣然接受指导并加以运用。

statement.en: Plays alongside other children happily.
statement.zh: 能与同伴愉快地平行游戏。

emerging.en: Plays near others but mostly watches.

developing.en: Plays alongside others comfortably.
developing.zh: 能自在地与同伴平行游戏。

secure.en: Plays alongside and swaps a few words or materials.
secure.zh: 平行游戏中会交流几句或交换材料。

statement.en: Notices when another child is nearby and makes room.
statement.zh: 会注意到同伴在旁并让出空间。

emerging.en: Needs a reminder to make space.

developing.en: Makes room when asked.
developing.zh: 被请求时会让出空间。

secure.en: Notices and makes room without being asked.
secure.zh: 会主动注意并让出空间。

statement.en: Joins in a shared activity with one or two children.
statement.zh: 能与一两个同伴一起参与活动。

emerging.en: Joins when invited by an adult.

developing.en: Joins a small group on most days.
developing.zh: 多数日子能加入小组。

secure.en: Joins in and helps the group keep going.
secure.zh: 加入并帮助小组继续进行。

statement.en: Takes turns in a game with a little support.
statement.zh: 在少量支持下能在游戏中轮流。

emerging.en: Finds turn-taking hard.

developing.en: Takes turns after a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒能轮流。

secure.en: Takes turns and reminds others kindly.
secure.zh: 能轮流并友善地提醒他人。

statement.en: Works with others on a shared plan.
statement.zh: 能与同伴共同完成一个计划。

emerging.en: Works beside others on the same thing.
emerging.zh: 与同伴做同一件事但各做各的。

developing.en: Agrees a simple plan with one child.
developing.zh: 能与一个同伴商定简单计划。

secure.en: Plans with a group and shares out the roles.
secure.zh: 能与小组共同计划并分工。

statement.en: Sorts out a small disagreement with words.
statement.zh: 能用语言解决小冲突。

emerging.en: Comes to an adult to settle it.

developing.en: Uses words with an adult nearby.
developing.zh: 成人在旁时能用语言处理。

secure.en: Settles small disagreements independently.
secure.zh: 能独立解决小冲突。

statement.en: Shows their feelings clearly and can be comforted.
statement.zh: 能清楚表达情绪并接受安慰。

emerging.en: Shows strong feelings and needs a lot of comfort.
emerging.zh: 情绪强烈，需要大量安抚。

developing.en: Shows feelings and settles with comfort.
developing.zh: 表达情绪后经安慰能平静。

secure.en: Shows feelings and settles quickly.
secure.zh: 表达情绪后能很快平静。

statement.en: Recognises happy and sad in faces and stories.
statement.zh: 能在表情和故事中辨认高兴和难过。

emerging.en: Notices a strong feeling in a face.

developing.en: Points to happy or sad when asked.
developing.zh: 被问到时能指出高兴或难过。

secure.en: Names happy and sad and says why.
secure.zh: 能说出高兴、难过并说明原因。

statement.en: Names how they are feeling.
statement.zh: 能说出自己的感受。

emerging.en: Shows the feeling without naming it.
emerging.zh: 表现出情绪但说不出名称。

developing.en: Names a feeling when prompted.
developing.zh: 经提示能说出一种情绪。

secure.en: Names feelings as they happen.
secure.zh: 能在当下说出自己的感受。

statement.en: Notices when another child is upset.
statement.zh: 能注意到同伴不开心。

emerging.en: Notices when it is pointed out.

developing.en: Notices and tells an adult.
developing.zh: 注意到并告诉成人。

secure.en: Notices and responds kindly.
secure.zh: 注意到并友善回应。

statement.en: Talks about why they feel a certain way.
statement.zh: 能说出自己为什么会有这种感受。

emerging.en: Names the feeling only.

developing.en: Gives a simple reason.
developing.zh: 能给出简单的原因。

secure.en: Explains the reason and what would help.
secure.zh: 能说明原因和什么会有帮助。

statement.en: Offers comfort or help to a child who is upset.
statement.zh: 会主动安慰或帮助难过的同伴。

emerging.en: Watches with concern.

developing.en: Offers help when it is suggested.
developing.zh: 经建议会提供帮助。

secure.en: Offers comfort in their own way, unprompted.
secure.zh: 会用自己的方式主动安慰。

statement.en: Copies a greeting with a familiar adult or child.
statement.zh: 能模仿与熟悉的人打招呼。

emerging.en: Watches the greeting.

developing.en: Copies the greeting when prompted.
developing.zh: 经提示能模仿打招呼。

secure.en: Greets by copying, without a prompt.
secure.zh: 无需提示就能模仿问候。

statement.en: Begins to use please and thank you with reminders.
statement.zh: 在提醒下开始使用"请"和"谢谢"。

emerging.en: Uses them when they are said first.

developing.en: Uses them after a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒后会使用。

secure.en: Uses them most of the time.
secure.zh: 多数时候都会使用。

statement.en: Greets visitors and says goodbye without prompting.
statement.zh: 能主动问候来访者并道别。

emerging.en: Greets when prompted.

developing.en: Greets most visitors alone.
developing.zh: 多数来访者都能自己问候。

secure.en: Greets and says goodbye warmly every time.
secure.zh: 每次都热情地问候和道别。

statement.en: Waits for a pause before joining a conversation.
statement.zh: 会等待谈话的间隙再加入。

emerging.en: Interrupts and needs a reminder.

developing.en: Waits when reminded of the signal.
developing.zh: 经提醒会等待信号。

secure.en: Waits for a pause by themselves.
secure.zh: 能自己等待谈话间隙。

statement.en: Uses the classroom courtesies naturally through the day.
statement.zh: 全天自然地使用班级礼仪。

emerging.en: Uses courtesies at set moments.
emerging.zh: 只在固定时刻使用礼仪。

developing.en: Uses courtesies through much of the day.
developing.zh: 一天中大部分时间使用礼仪。

secure.en: Courtesy is part of how they move through the day.
secure.zh: 礼仪已成为其自然的一部分。

statement.en: Helps a younger child learn a routine.
statement.zh: 能帮助年幼的同伴学习常规。

emerging.en: Notices a younger child needing help.
emerging.zh: 注意到年幼同伴需要帮助。

developing.en: Helps when asked.
developing.zh: 被请求时会帮忙。

secure.en: Helps a younger child patiently and unprompted.
secure.zh: 会耐心地主动帮助年幼同伴。

statement.en: Uses a whole-hand or three-finger grip to hold a tool.
statement.zh: 能用全手或三指握持工具。

emerging.en: Holds with a whole-hand grip.

developing.en: Uses a three-finger grip some of the time.
developing.zh: 有时能用三指握持。

secure.en: Uses a three-finger grip comfortably.
secure.zh: 能舒适地使用三指握持。

statement.en: Threads large beads or uses tongs to move objects.
statement.zh: 能穿大珠子或用夹子夹取物品。

emerging.en: Manages with hand-over-hand help.

developing.en: Manages a few on their own.
developing.zh: 能自己完成几个。

secure.en: Threads or transfers a whole set smoothly.
secure.zh: 能顺利完成整套穿珠或转移。

statement.en: Holds a pencil comfortably between fingers and thumb.
statement.zh: 能用手指和拇指舒适地握笔。

emerging.en: Grip is tight or changes often.

developing.en: Holds correctly for short spells.
developing.zh: 短时间内握姿正确。

secure.en: Holds correctly and comfortably throughout.
secure.zh: 全程握姿正确且舒适。

statement.en: Uses scissors to cut along a line.
statement.zh: 能用剪刀沿线剪。

emerging.en: Snips at the edge of the paper.

developing.en: Cuts along a straight line.
developing.zh: 能沿直线剪。

secure.en: Cuts along straight and curved lines accurately.
secure.zh: 能准确地沿直线和曲线剪。

statement.en: Draws and writes with steady control.
statement.zh: 画画和书写时手部控制稳定。

emerging.en: Lines are large and uneven.

developing.en: Control is steady for short pieces.
developing.zh: 短篇书写时控制稳定。

secure.en: Control is steady and sized to the paper.
secure.zh: 控制稳定且大小得当。

statement.en: Fastens buttons, zips and small catches.
statement.zh: 能扣纽扣、拉拉链和扣小搭扣。

emerging.en: Manages large fastenings with help.
emerging.zh: 在帮助下能完成大的扣件。

developing.en: Manages most fastenings alone.
developing.zh: 多数扣件能自己完成。

secure.en: Manages all the classroom fastenings independently.
secure.zh: 能独立完成教室里所有扣件。

statement.en: Walks, runs and climbs with growing steadiness.
statement.zh: 走、跑、攀爬越来越稳。

emerging.en: Moves steadily on flat ground.

developing.en: Runs and climbs with growing confidence.
developing.zh: 跑和爬越来越有信心。

secure.en: Moves confidently over different surfaces.
secure.zh: 在不同地面都能自信移动。

statement.en: Carries a tray or a jug across the room without spilling.
statement.zh: 能端着托盘或水壶走过教室而不洒。

emerging.en: Carries with an adult’s hand.

developing.en: Carries a light tray alone.
developing.zh: 能独自端轻的托盘。

secure.en: Carries a full jug carefully across the room.
secure.zh: 能小心地把满水壶端过教室。

statement.en: Balances on one foot for a few seconds.
statement.zh: 能单脚站立几秒。

emerging.en: Balances briefly with support.

developing.en: Balances a few seconds on the stronger foot.
developing.zh: 惯用脚能站立几秒。

secure.en: Balances on either foot for several seconds.
secure.zh: 双脚都能站立数秒。

statement.en: Moves carefully around others and around work on the floor.
statement.zh: 能小心地绕过同伴和地上的工作。

emerging.en: Needs reminders about mats and space.
emerging.zh: 需提醒注意工作毯和空间。

developing.en: Moves around most work carefully.
developing.zh: 多数情况能小心绕行。

secure.en: Moves through a busy room without disturbing anyone.
secure.zh: 能在忙碌的教室中穿行而不打扰他人。

statement.en: Hops, skips and changes direction with control.
statement.zh: 能有控制地单脚跳、跳跃并变换方向。

emerging.en: Hops on the spot.

developing.en: Hops and skips a short distance.
developing.zh: 能跳跃一小段距离。

secure.en: Hops, skips and turns with control.
secure.zh: 能有控制地跳跃和转向。

statement.en: Carries and places heavy or awkward material safely.
statement.zh: 能安全地搬运和放置较重或不易拿的材料。

emerging.en: Carries light material alone.

developing.en: Carries heavier material with care.
developing.zh: 能小心搬运较重的材料。

secure.en: Judges what they can carry and asks for help when needed.
secure.zh: 能判断自己搬得动什么，并在需要时求助。

statement.en: Washes and dries hands with a reminder.
statement.zh: 经提醒能洗手擦干。

emerging.en: Washes with an adult guiding.

developing.en: Washes and dries after a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒能洗手擦干。

secure.en: Washes and dries thoroughly by themselves.
secure.zh: 能自己彻底洗净擦干。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标2(3-4岁)

statement.en: Puts on shoes or a coat with some help.
statement.zh: 在一些帮助下能穿鞋或外套。

emerging.en: Holds out arms and feet to be dressed.

developing.en: Manages part of it alone.
developing.zh: 能自己完成一部分。

secure.en: Manages shoes or coat with only fastenings left.
secure.zh: 除扣件外都能自己完成。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标2(3-4岁)

statement.en: Manages their own coat, shoes and bag.
statement.zh: 能自己管理外套、鞋子和书包。

emerging.en: Manages one of the three alone.
emerging.zh: 三样中能自己完成一样。

developing.en: Manages most of them alone.
developing.zh: 多数能自己完成。

secure.en: Manages all three and puts them away.
secure.zh: 三样都能完成并收好。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标2(4-5岁)

statement.en: Serves their own snack and clears it away.
statement.zh: 能自己取点心并收拾干净。

emerging.en: Serves with an adult beside them.

developing.en: Serves and clears after a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒能取用并收拾。

secure.en: Serves, eats and clears the place fully alone.
secure.zh: 能独立取用、进食并完全收拾。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标2(4-5岁)

statement.en: Looks after their own belongings all day.
statement.zh: 全天能照管好自己的物品。

emerging.en: Needs reminders about belongings.

developing.en: Keeps track of belongings on most days.
developing.zh: 多数日子能管好物品。

secure.en: Keeps belongings in order without reminders.
secure.zh: 无需提醒就能保持物品整齐。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标2(5-6岁)

statement.en: Notices what they need and gets it themselves.
statement.zh: 能察觉自己的需要并自行取用。

emerging.en: Tells an adult what they need.
emerging.zh: 会告诉成人自己需要什么。

developing.en: Gets what they need when reminded where it is.
developing.zh: 经提醒位置后能自己去取。

secure.en: Notices and gets what they need independently.
secure.zh: 能自己察觉并取用所需。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标2(5-6岁)

statement.en: Helps put a material back on the shelf.
statement.zh: 能帮助把材料放回架上。

emerging.en: Puts it back when it is handed to them.

developing.en: Puts it back after a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒会放回。

secure.en: Puts it back in the right place by themselves.
secure.zh: 能自己放回正确位置。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标3(3-4岁)

statement.en: Wipes a spill when shown.
statement.zh: 经示范能擦拭洒出的东西。

emerging.en: Watches an adult wipe.

developing.en: Wipes with help.
developing.zh: 在帮助下擦拭。

secure.en: Fetches the cloth and wipes alone.
secure.zh: 能自己去拿抹布并擦干净。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标3(3-4岁)

statement.en: Returns work complete and ready for the next child.
statement.zh: 能把工作完整地整理好，供下一个孩子使用。

emerging.en: Returns work with pieces missing.

developing.en: Returns work complete after a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒能完整放回。

secure.en: Checks the work is complete before returning it.
secure.zh: 放回前会检查是否完整。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标3(4-5岁)

statement.en: Uses cloths, brushes and jugs for their proper purpose.
statement.zh: 能正确使用抹布、刷子和水壶。

emerging.en: Explores the tools in play.

developing.en: Uses each tool correctly after a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒能正确使用工具。

secure.en: Chooses and uses the right tool for the job.
secure.zh: 能选择并正确使用合适的工具。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标3(4-5岁)

statement.en: Takes care of the room without being asked.
statement.zh: 无需要求即能照顾教室环境。

emerging.en: Tidies when asked.

developing.en: Notices and tidies their own area.
developing.zh: 会注意并整理自己的区域。

secure.en: Notices what the room needs and does it.
secure.zh: 能察觉教室的需要并去做。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标3(5-6岁)

statement.en: Shows another child how to care for a material.
statement.zh: 能向同伴示范如何爱护材料。

emerging.en: Tells a child not to spoil a material.

developing.en: Shows a child what to do when asked.
developing.zh: 被请求时会示范。

secure.en: Shows a child carefully and patiently, unprompted.
secure.zh: 会主动耐心地示范给同伴。

chinaMoe: 健康.生活习惯与生活能力.目标3(5-6岁)

statement.en: Draws on purpose and says what it means.
statement.zh: 有意识地涂画并说出它的意思。

emerging.en: Draws freely, without meaning attached.

developing.en: Says what a drawing means when asked.
developing.zh: 被问到时能说出含义。

secure.en: Draws something and tells you what it says.
secure.zh: 会画下图形并说出它写的是什么。

chinaMoe: 语言.阅读与书写准备.目标3(3-4岁)

statement.en: Draws lines, circles and shapes with growing control.
statement.zh: 画线条、圆形和图形的控制力增强。

emerging.en: Scribbles with whole-arm movement.

developing.en: Draws lines and circles on purpose.
developing.zh: 能有意识地画线和圆。

secure.en: Draws recognisable shapes on request.
secure.zh: 能按要求画出可辨认的图形。

chinaMoe: 语言.阅读与书写准备.目标3(3-4岁)

statement.en: Writes some of the letters in their own name.
statement.zh: 能写出自己名字中的一些字母。

emerging.en: Copies one letter of their name.

developing.en: Writes two or three letters of their name.
developing.zh: 能写出名字中的两三个字母。

secure.en: Writes most of their name unaided.
secure.zh: 能独立写出名字的大部分。

chinaMoe: 语言.阅读与书写准备.目标3(4-5岁)

statement.en: Uses letter shapes in their drawing and play.
statement.zh: 在绘画和游戏中使用字母形状。

emerging.en: Includes letter-like shapes.

developing.en: Includes real letters among the shapes.
developing.zh: 记号中出现真正的字母。

secure.en: Labels drawings with letters they know.
secure.zh: 会用认识的字母给画作标注。

chinaMoe: 语言.阅读与书写准备.目标3(4-5岁)

statement.en: Writes their own name clearly.
statement.zh: 能清楚地写出自己的名字。

emerging.en: Writes their name with a model to copy.

developing.en: Writes their name from memory, letters uneven.
developing.zh: 能凭记忆写出，字母不匀。

secure.en: Writes their name clearly and consistently.
secure.zh: 能清楚一致地写出名字。

chinaMoe: 语言.阅读与书写准备.目标3(5-6岁)

statement.en: Writes short taught words using the sounds they know.
statement.zh: 能用学过的音写出简短的词。

emerging.en: Writes the first sound of a word only.

developing.en: Writes the first and last sounds.
developing.zh: 能写出首尾两个音。

secure.en: Writes short taught words readably.
secure.zh: 能写出可读的学过短词。

chinaMoe: 语言.阅读与书写准备.目标3(5-6岁)

statement.en: Notices and points out changes around them.
statement.zh: 能注意并指出周围的变化。

emerging.en: Notices when it is pointed out.

developing.en: Points out changes they notice.
developing.zh: 会指出自己注意到的变化。

secure.en: Notices changes and talks about them.
secure.zh: 注意到变化并加以谈论。

statement.en: Explores materials with all their senses.
statement.zh: 会用多种感官探索材料。

emerging.en: Explores by looking and touching.

developing.en: Explores with several senses.
developing.zh: 会用多种感官探索。

secure.en: Explores carefully and describes what they notice.
secure.zh: 仔细探索并描述所发现的。

statement.en: Asks questions about how and why things happen.
statement.zh: 会问事情如何发生、为什么发生。

emerging.en: Asks what something is.

developing.en: Asks how something works.
developing.zh: 问"这怎么用"。

secure.en: Asks why, and listens to the answer.
secure.zh: 会问"为什么"并倾听回答。

statement.en: Talks about their family and the people in their community.
statement.zh: 能谈论家人和社区中的人。

emerging.en: Names family members.

developing.en: Talks about family and one community role.
developing.zh: 能谈家人和一种社区角色。

secure.en: Talks about family, neighbours and the jobs people do.
secure.zh: 能谈家人、邻居和人们的工作。

statement.en: Makes a guess about what will happen and checks it.
statement.zh: 能预测将会发生什么并加以验证。

emerging.en: Says what they think will happen.

developing.en: Guesses and watches what happens.
developing.zh: 猜测后会观察结果。

secure.en: Guesses, checks, and says whether they were right.
secure.zh: 猜测、验证并说出对错。

statement.en: Talks about living things, the weather or the seasons with some detail.
statement.zh: 能较详细地谈论生物、天气或季节。

emerging.en: Names a plant, animal or weather word.
emerging.zh: 能说出植物、动物或天气的名称。

developing.en: Describes one of them in a sentence.
developing.zh: 能用一句话描述其中一样。

secure.en: Explains a change and gives a reason.
secure.zh: 能解释变化并说明原因。

statement.en: Works with deep focus on one activity for a long stretch.
statement.zh: 能长时间专注地做一项活动。

emerging.en: Stays with an activity for a few minutes before moving on.
emerging.zh: 能投入几分钟后就转去做别的。

developing.en: Works for a good stretch and comes back after a short break.
developing.zh: 能投入较长一段时间，短暂离开后会回来继续。

secure.en: Works right through a long stretch and would rather not be interrupted.
secure.zh: 能一气呵成地长时间工作，不愿被打断。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (self-management)

statement.en: Picks up work begun on another day and carries it through to the end.
statement.zh: 能接着前几天开始的工作继续做到完成。

emerging.en: Starts again from the beginning, or leaves it.
emerging.zh: 要么从头再来，要么放下不做。

developing.en: Picks it up again once someone reminds them where they stopped.
developing.zh: 经人提醒上次做到哪里后能接着做。

secure.en: Finds their own work, sees where they stopped, and finishes it.
secure.zh: 能自己找到工作、看出上次停在哪里并完成它。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (setting and working towards goals)

statement.en: Chooses their own work and begins it without being told.
statement.zh: 能自己选择工作并主动开始。

emerging.en: Waits to be pointed towards something.

developing.en: Chooses on most days, with a word from an adult now and then.
developing.zh: 多数日子能自己选择，偶尔需要成人提一句。

secure.en: Comes in, decides, and begins on their own.
secure.zh: 进教室后能自己决定并开始工作。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Living in the Wider World (taking responsibility)

statement.en: Asks a question when they are unsure what to do, instead of stopping.
statement.zh: 不确定该怎么做时会开口提问，而不是停下来。

emerging.en: Goes quiet or waits when stuck.

developing.en: Asks once an adult comes near.
developing.zh: 成人走近时才会问。

secure.en: Seeks someone out and asks a clear question.
secure.zh: 会主动找人并把问题问清楚。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Spoken language: ask relevant questions to extend understanding

statement.en: Tries a way of their own before asking an adult for help.
statement.zh: 在向成人求助前会先自己试一种办法。

emerging.en: Asks for help as soon as something is hard.

developing.en: Tries once, then asks.
developing.zh: 会试一次，然后求助。

secure.en: Tries more than one way, and can say what they tried.
secure.zh: 会尝试不止一种办法，并能说出自己试过什么。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — Science: working scientifically (solving problems practically)

statement.en: Looks back over their own work and puts right whatever does not look right.
statement.zh: 会回头检查自己的工作，并改正看起来不对的地方。

emerging.en: Says it is finished without looking back over it.
emerging.zh: 不回头检查就说做完了。

developing.en: Looks back when asked, and changes what an adult points out.
developing.zh: 经要求会回头看，并改成人指出的地方。

secure.en: Looks back without being asked and puts things right on their own.
secure.zh: 不用别人说就会回头检查并自行改正。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Word reading: re-reading to check the text makes sense

statement.en: Moves calmly from one activity to the next with little help.
statement.zh: 能平静地从一项活动过渡到下一项，几乎不需要帮助。

emerging.en: Needs an adult alongside them at each change.
emerging.zh: 每次转换都需要成人陪在身边。

developing.en: Moves on with a reminder, and settles again quickly.
developing.zh: 经提醒能转换，并很快重新投入。

secure.en: Finishes, tidies and moves on without being prompted.
secure.zh: 能自行收尾、整理并转入下一项。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (managing change and routines)

statement.en: Waits their turn and holds back a first impulse when the moment calls for it.
statement.zh: 能等待轮到自己，并在需要时忍住第一反应。

emerging.en: Acts straight away and finds waiting hard.

developing.en: Waits with a reminder, for a short time.
developing.zh: 经提醒能短暂等待。

secure.en: Waits, and stops themselves without anyone saying anything.
secure.zh: 能自行等待并克制自己，无需他人提醒。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (self-regulation)

statement.en: Talks with a familiar adult about their own work and what they are trying to do.
statement.zh: 能与熟悉的成人谈自己的工作和想做的事。

emerging.en: Answers a direct question about the work.
emerging.zh: 别人直接问起时才回答。

developing.en: Shows the work and says a little about it.
developing.zh: 会展示工作并简单说一说。

secure.en: Starts the conversation and explains what they are aiming for.
secure.zh: 会主动开口，并说明自己想达成什么。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Spoken language: give well-structured explanations

statement.en: Asks an adult for what they need, in words, at a good moment.
statement.zh: 能在合适的时机用语言向成人表达需要。

emerging.en: Shows what they need without words, or waits.
emerging.zh: 用动作示意或干等，不开口。

developing.en: Asks, but often breaks in on something else.
developing.zh: 会开口，但常挑错时机。

secure.en: Waits for a good moment and asks clearly.
secure.zh: 会等合适的时机并清楚地提出。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Spoken language: speak audibly and fluently

statement.en: Takes turns in a group activity without an adult reminding them.
statement.zh: 在集体活动中能自觉轮流，不需成人提醒。

emerging.en: Takes turns when an adult manages it.

developing.en: Takes turns with an occasional reminder.
developing.zh: 偶尔需要提醒就能轮流。

secure.en: Keeps the turns going, and helps others keep them too.
secure.zh: 能自觉轮流，还会帮助同伴一起遵守。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Spoken language: take turns in discussion

statement.en: Builds on what another child has just said in a conversation.
statement.zh: 在交谈中能接着同伴刚说的话往下说。

emerging.en: Talks alongside others rather than to them.
emerging.zh: 各说各的，较少互相回应。

developing.en: Answers a peer, then moves to their own subject.
developing.zh: 会回应同伴，但很快转回自己的话题。

secure.en: Picks up a peer’s idea and adds to it across several exchanges.
secure.zh: 能接住同伴的想法并连续几轮往下谈。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Spoken language: build on the contributions of others

statement.en: Names how they feel with a word that fits, not only happy or sad.
statement.zh: 能用贴切的词说出自己的感受，而不只是"开心"或"难过"。

emerging.en: Uses happy or sad for most feelings.
emerging.zh: 大多只用开心或难过来表达。

developing.en: Finds a more exact word with a little help.
developing.zh: 在稍加引导下能找到更贴切的词。

secure.en: Chooses a word that fits, and says what brought the feeling on.
secure.zh: 能选出贴切的词，并说出感受的由来。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (feelings and emotions)

statement.en: Uses a way of their own to settle when they are upset.
statement.zh: 难过时能用自己的办法平复情绪。

emerging.en: Needs an adult to settle them.
emerging.zh: 需要成人帮助才能平复。

developing.en: Uses a familiar way when reminded of it.
developing.zh: 经提醒能用熟悉的办法。

secure.en: Chooses a way and uses it without being asked.
secure.zh: 能自行选择并使用平复的办法。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (managing feelings)

statement.en: Greets, thanks and asks politely without being prompted.
statement.zh: 能主动问候、道谢并礼貌地提出请求。

emerging.en: Uses courteous words when reminded.
emerging.zh: 经提醒会使用礼貌用语。

developing.en: Uses them with familiar people most of the time.
developing.zh: 面对熟悉的人时多数能做到。

secure.en: Uses them with everyone, including visitors, unprompted.
secure.zh: 对所有人（包括来访者）都能主动做到。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Relationships (courtesy and respect)

statement.en: Settles a small disagreement with a friend using words.
statement.zh: 能用语言化解与同伴之间的小分歧。

emerging.en: Comes to an adult with the disagreement.

developing.en: Talks it through with an adult nearby.
developing.zh: 在成人在旁时能谈开。

secure.en: Talks it through with the other child on their own.
secure.zh: 能自己和同伴谈开并解决。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Relationships (managing disagreement)

statement.en: Writes a sentence of their own with a capital letter, spaces between the words and a full stop.
statement.zh: 能自己写出一句话，句首大写、词间留空、句末有句号。

emerging.en: Writes words, with the spaces or the capital letter still coming.
emerging.zh: 能写出词，但空格或大写还不稳定。

developing.en: Writes a sentence with most of the punctuation in place.
developing.zh: 能写出句子，大部分标点和大写都到位。

secure.en: Writes a sentence with the capital, the spaces and the full stop all in place.
secure.zh: 写出的句子大写、空格和句号都齐全。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Writing: leaving spaces between words, capital letters and full stops

statement.en: Writes a short piece of two or more sentences that holds together from beginning to end.
statement.zh: 能写出两句以上、前后连贯的短文。

emerging.en: Writes one sentence at a time, each on its own.
emerging.zh: 一次只写一句，句与句之间没有联系。

developing.en: Writes two or three sentences on one subject.
developing.zh: 能围绕一个话题写两三句。

secure.en: Writes a short piece with a clear beginning and a closing idea.
secure.zh: 能写出有开头也有收尾的短文。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Writing: sequencing sentences to form short narratives

statement.en: Asks a question about the world and suggests a way to find out.
statement.zh: 能提出关于世界的问题，并想出一种寻找答案的办法。

emerging.en: Notices something and says what they see.
emerging.zh: 能注意到现象并说出所见。

developing.en: Asks a question about it.
developing.zh: 会就此提出问题。

secure.en: Asks a question and suggests how they could find out.
secure.zh: 既能提问，也能说出可以怎样去找答案。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — Science: working scientifically (asking simple questions)

statement.en: Keeps a simple record of what they notice and says what it shows.
statement.zh: 能把观察到的内容简单记录下来，并说出记录说明了什么。

emerging.en: Talks about what they noticed without recording it.
emerging.zh: 能说出观察到的，但不做记录。

developing.en: Draws or tallies what they noticed.
developing.zh: 会用画图或计数的方式记录。

secure.en: Records it in a chart or tally and says what it shows.
secure.zh: 能用表格或计数记录，并说出其中的意思。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — Science: working scientifically (gathering and recording data)

statement.en: Forms letters and numerals starting in the right place and moving in the right direction.
statement.zh: 写字母和数字时起笔位置和运笔方向都正确。

emerging.en: Forms them recognisably, starting in various places.
emerging.zh: 能写得认得出，但起笔位置不定。

developing.en: Forms most of them the right way round.
developing.zh: 大部分字形的方向正确。

secure.en: Forms letters and numerals correctly and comfortably, at speed.
secure.zh: 能正确、轻松且较快地书写字母和数字。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Handwriting: form lower-case letters in the correct direction

statement.en: Uses scissors and other classroom tools accurately and safely.
statement.zh: 能准确、安全地使用剪刀和其他教室用具。

emerging.en: Uses a tool with an adult alongside.
emerging.zh: 需成人在旁才能使用工具。

developing.en: Uses familiar tools on their own, roughly accurately.
developing.zh: 能独立使用熟悉的工具，准确度一般。

secure.en: Uses tools accurately, and puts them away safely.
secure.zh: 能准确使用工具，并安全归位。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — Design and Technology: using tools safely

statement.en: Throws, catches or kicks with control in a game.
statement.zh: 在游戏中能有控制地投掷、接住或踢球。

emerging.en: Sends and stops a ball at close range.
emerging.zh: 近距离能把球送出并挡住。

developing.en: Catches or kicks accurately most of the time.
developing.zh: 多数时候能准确接住或踢中。

secure.en: Keeps control of the ball inside a game with others.
secure.zh: 在与同伴的游戏中能持续控球。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — Physical Education: master basic movements including throwing and catching

statement.en: Puts movements together — hopping, skipping, jumping — and keeps their balance.
statement.zh: 能把跳、蹦、单脚跳等动作连起来并保持平衡。

emerging.en: Performs one movement at a time.

developing.en: Links two movements with a pause between.
developing.zh: 能把两个动作连起来，中间会停顿。

secure.en: Links several movements smoothly, staying balanced.
secure.zh: 能流畅地连贯多个动作并保持平衡。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — Physical Education: developing balance, agility and co-ordination

statement.en: Looks after their own belongings and personal care without an adult.
statement.zh: 能自己照顾好个人物品和生活自理，不需成人帮忙。

emerging.en: Manages with a step-by-step reminder.
emerging.zh: 需要一步步提醒才能完成。

developing.en: Manages most of it independently.
developing.zh: 大部分能独立完成。

secure.en: Manages it all, and notices when something is missing.
secure.zh: 全部能独立完成，还能发现东西少了。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (personal care and independence)

statement.en: Gets themselves ready for what comes next without being told.
statement.zh: 不用别人说就能为下一项活动做好准备。

emerging.en: Follows the group once it has started moving.
emerging.zh: 要等大家开始行动才跟上。

developing.en: Gets ready with a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒能做好准备。

secure.en: Sees what is coming and gets ready on their own.
secure.zh: 能预见接下来的安排并自行准备好。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Health and Wellbeing (routines and organisation)

statement.en: Sets up what they need and clears it all away afterwards.
statement.zh: 能自己准备所需材料，用完后全部收拾归位。

emerging.en: Clears away when asked.

developing.en: Sets up and clears away with a reminder.
developing.zh: 经提醒能准备和收拾。

secure.en: Sets up, clears away and leaves the space ready for the next child.
secure.zh: 能准备、收拾，并把环境留给下一个孩子。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Living in the Wider World (caring for the shared environment)

statement.en: Keeps up a job for the classroom right across the week.
statement.zh: 能坚持完成一整周的班级职责。

emerging.en: Does the job on the day they are reminded.

developing.en: Does it most days of the week.
developing.zh: 一周中大部分日子会做。

secure.en: Does it every day without being reminded.
secure.zh: 每天都主动完成，无需提醒。

crosswalk.ukNc: Key Stage 1 — PSHE: Living in the Wider World (responsibility in the community)

statement.en: Answers a question about something read aloud, including one they have to work out for themselves.
statement.zh: 能回答关于朗读内容的问题，包括需要自己推想才能答出的问题。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Reading comprehension: making inferences on the basis of what is being said and done

statement.en: Follows a spoken instruction with three parts, in order, the first time it is said.
statement.zh: 能一次听清并按顺序完成含三个步骤的口头指令。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Spoken language: listen and respond appropriately to adults and their peers

statement.en: Retells a story in order and says what someone did or how they felt.
statement.zh: 能按顺序复述故事，并说出人物做了什么或有什么感受。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Reading comprehension: retelling and discussing significant events

statement.en: Says what a word means in their own words, and groups words that belong together.
statement.zh: 能用自己的话说出词义，并把同一类的词归在一起。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Reading comprehension: discussing word meanings and linking new meanings to those already known

statement.en: Says every sound in a spoken word, in order.
statement.zh: 能按顺序说出一个词里的每一个音。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Word reading: applying phonic knowledge and skill as the route to decode words

statement.en: Hears whether two words have the same middle vowel sound.
statement.zh: 能听出两个词中间的元音是否相同。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Word reading: respond speedily with the correct sound to graphemes

statement.en: Reads a word with a two-letter sound or a vowel team by sounding it out — even a word they have never seen.
statement.zh: 能通过拼读读出含双字母音或元音组合的词，包括从未见过的词。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Word reading: blend sounds in unfamiliar words containing taught GPCs · Year 1 phonics check (made-up words)

statement.en: Reads a short sentence and shows they know what it says.
statement.zh: 能读出一句短句，并表明自己明白句子的意思。

crosswalk.ukNc: English Year 1 — Word reading: read aloud books closely matched to their improving phonic knowledge

statement.en: Counts on past one hundred from any number, and counts in tens and in fives.
statement.zh: 能从任意数往上数过一百，并能十个十个、五个五个地数。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Number and place value: count to and across 100, forwards and backwards, from any given number

statement.en: Knows what each digit in a two-digit number stands for, and uses that to say which number is larger.
statement.zh: 知道两位数中每个数位的含义，并据此判断哪个数更大。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Number and place value: represent and compare numbers using tens and ones

statement.en: Adds and takes away within twenty in a way that works for them.
statement.zh: 能用适合自己的方法在二十以内进行加法和减法。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Addition and subtraction: number bonds and related subtraction facts within 20

statement.en: Works out an everyday problem that needs adding or taking away.
statement.zh: 能解决需要用加法或减法的日常生活问题。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Addition and subtraction: solve one-step problems with concrete objects and pictorial representations

statement.en: Names a solid shape and says one thing that is true of every one of them.
statement.zh: 能说出立体图形的名称，并说出这类形体共有的一个特点。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Geometry: recognise and name common 3-D shapes

statement.en: Finds a half and a quarter of a shape, and notices when the parts are not equal.
statement.zh: 能找出图形的二分之一和四分之一，并看出各部分是否相等。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Fractions: recognise, find and name a half and a quarter

statement.en: Reads the time on a clock at the hour and at half past.
statement.zh: 能读出钟面上的整点和半点时间。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Measurement: tell the time to the hour and half past the hour

statement.en: Compares three things and picks out the longest, the tallest or the shortest.
statement.zh: 能比较三样东西，并找出最长、最高或最短的那一个。

crosswalk.ukNc: Mathematics Year 1 — Measurement: compare, describe and solve practical problems for lengths and heights

statement.en: Points to everyday classroom things named in English.
statement.zh: 听到英语说出的日常教室物品名称时能指出来。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — receptive vocabulary (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)
crosswalk.otherAnchor: Primary EFL practice — picture-pointing receptive vocabulary

statement.en: Points to the picture for an English word about doing something or about where something is.
statement.zh: 听到表示动作或位置的英语词时能指出相应的图片。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — receptive vocabulary (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)
crosswalk.otherAnchor: Primary EFL practice — picture-pointing receptive vocabulary

statement.en: Follows a spoken English instruction with three parts.
statement.zh: 能听懂并完成含三个步骤的英语口头指令。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — listening (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Follows an English instruction that says which part to do first.
statement.zh: 能听懂含先后次序的英语指令并按序完成。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — listening (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Hears the middle sound in a short English word.
statement.zh: 能听出英语短词中间的那个音。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — phonological awareness (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Blends English sounds said one at a time into a whole word.
statement.zh: 能把一个一个说出的英语音合成完整的词。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — phonological awareness (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Finds the two letters that make a given English sound.
statement.zh: 能找出发出某个英语音的那两个字母。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — letter and sound knowledge (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Says the sound two letters make together.
statement.zh: 能说出两个字母组合在一起发出的音。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — letter and sound knowledge (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Reads an English word containing a two-letter sound or a vowel team.
statement.zh: 能读出含双字母音或元音组合的英语词。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — word reading (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Reads a short English sentence and shows they know what it says.
statement.zh: 能读出一句英语短句，并表明自己明白它的意思。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — word reading (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)

statement.en: Asks a simple question in English.
statement.zh: 能用英语提出一个简单的问题。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — spoken production (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)
crosswalk.otherAnchor: Primary EFL practice — modelled question frames

statement.en: Describes a picture in English in a short sentence.
statement.zh: 能用一句简短的英语描述一张图片。

crosswalk.ukNc: English as an additional language — spoken production (no CEFR or Cambridge level is claimed)
crosswalk.otherAnchor: Primary EFL practice — modelled question frames

statement.en: Reads a word with two letters that make one sound.
statement.zh: 能读出含两个字母发一个音的词。

statement.en: Reads a whole short sentence aloud.
statement.zh: 能把一句短句完整地读出来。

statement.en: Counts on past one hundred from a number they are given.
statement.zh: 能从给定的数往上数过一百。

statement.en: Adds and takes away within twenty.
statement.zh: 能在二十以内进行加法和减法。

statement.en: Finds a half of a shape.
statement.zh: 能找出图形的二分之一。

statement.en: Reads an English word with a taught two-letter sound.
statement.zh: 能读出含学过的双字母音的英语词。
